identity.name: CBC News
identity.description: The English-language news division of Canada's public broadcaster, covering Canadian and international affairs across television, radio and digital.

ownership.ownershipNotes: CBC is a Crown corporation funded through parliamentary appropriations and commercial revenue. It has a public-service mandate and statutory editorial independence.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Crown-corporation structure with journalistic independence provisions; coverage includes criticism of Canadian governments.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: MBFC rates Left-Center and High factual reporting; Canadian public-media framing is broadly centrist with a progressive social tilt.

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic coverage is policy-explanatory and social-service aware, without a consistent market or state-directed line.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Frames international events through Canadian and North American alliance perspectives.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC rates factual reporting High and credibility High; established public broadcaster with corrections.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: Left-Center; factual reporting High; credibility High (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Canadian public-broadcaster voice. Explains events through Canadian federalism, Indigenous reconciliation, public health and North American alliance politics.

selectionRationale: Adds a Canadian public-service perspective and North American coverage beyond US outlets.

research.researchNotes: Existing production mapping retained. The official governance page returned no extractable text in this pass. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
